summary: M4 VerifiedRoute/firewall existed in source/tests/scripts, but no runtime/bundle entry imported it and tsdown.config.ts did not declare it as a stable package dist entry. tsdown therefore omitted it from dist and npm pack omitted it from the tarball.

evidence.dist_before_repair: rg M4_VERIFIED_ROUTE/VERIFIED_ROUTE_UMC_V1_M4/umc.v1.m4.verified_route in dist exited 1 before repair
evidence.m3_m2_comparison: M3/M2 symbols are present in dist/agent-runner.runtime-DESbFJnG.js because followup-runner imports M3 and contains M2 queued route admission; M4 had no equivalent build graph edge
evidence.package_before_repair: M4_SOURCE_BUILD_PACKAGE_VALIDATION.json recorded tarball sha256 92634bc0a599a16a687e4ef50575f8ca8ade7d367afc47a16090949c61b1f7e5 with M4 artifact absent

ruled_out.BUILD_OUTPUT_NOT_INCLUDED_IN_PACKAGE: not primary; package files include dist/, but M4 was absent from dist
